thread_analysis.thread_summary: Teraoka Seiko / Espressif module BLE-only registration. Three issues surfaced: (1) the module vendor self-described as 'Component' but SIG registration shows Host + Controller Subsystem → Multi-Design (¥250K) applies; (2) RFQ stated BR/EDR/BLE but module is BLE-only — scope must be corrected; (3) module has integrated antenna → RF/RF PHY test exempt; TCW ES-25636 yellow warning is SIG-caused and self-resolves in 1–5 business days.
all_questions_found: Is this module Single Design or Multi-Design reference?
The RFQ says BR/EDR/BLE but the module is BLE-only — which scope should be registered?
Is the RF/RF PHY test required for a module with an integrated antenna?
A TCW ES-25636 yellow warning appeared — what does it mean and is it a blocker?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: Module QDID structure must be verified in SIG Launchstudio — vendor labels are unreliable. A Host + Controller Subsystem split requires Multi-Design reference. BLE-only modules must not include BR/EDR ICS items. RF/RF PHY test is exempt when the datasheet states integrated antenna or antenna connector. TCW ES-25636 is a known SIG Check Rule defect that generates a yellow warning; SIG resolves it internally after Submission in 1–5 business days.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: 1. Search QDID in Launchstudio to determine Single or Multi-Design. 2. Match registration scope to actual module features (BLE-only). 3. Check datasheet for antenna configuration to determine RF test exemption. 4. Treat TCW ES-25636 as a non-blocking SIG-side warning.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Misquoting Multi-Design as Single-Design causes ¥100K underquote. Wrong scope (BR/EDR for BLE-only) causes ICS errors requiring a project restart. Missing RF test exemption inflates costs unnecessarily.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: Quoting Single Design without verifying QDID structure in Launchstudio, or failing to confirm the module's actual Bluetooth feature set from the datasheet before building the provisional project.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Always verify the QDID registration structure in SIG Launchstudio (not from vendor literature) before quoting. Confirm Bluetooth mode and antenna configuration from the datasheet at intake.
